name: geoBoundaries -- gbOpen product only
notes: This record covers gbOpen ONLY. geoBoundaries publishes two other products under DIFFERENT terms that must NOT be conflated with this record: gbHumanitarian (mirrored from UN OCHA, 'may have less open licensure') and gbAuthoritative (mirrored from UN SALB, explicitly NOT usable commercially). If either of those is ever wanted, create a separate registry record for it -- do not extend this record's approval to cover them. Also note: individual per-country boundary layers within gbOpen may carry their own `boundaryLicense` metadata field that can differ from the blanket CC BY 4.0 label; spot-check before bulk ingest. Attribution: display 'geoBoundaries' prominently with a link to www.geoboundaries.org (or the full URL where a link isn't possible).
